assessment.assessment_title: RHEL 9 /var/log directory must have mode 0755 or less permissive.
assessment.evidence_guidance: Retain the completed source OCIL evidence and reviewer notes.
assessment.procedure:
Manual alternative preserved from the original OCIL check. Follow the source procedure; this Assessment does not execute OCIL.

Verify that the "/var/log" directory has a mode of "0755" or less permissive with the following command:

$ stat -c '%a %n' /var/log

755 /var/log

If "/var/log" does not have a mode of "0755" or less permissive, this is a finding.
